Hi Kimberly / Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week — CardioWave is looking forward to moving ahead. Before legal can push a PO, procurement needs the security/compliance artifacts and a completed vendor intake so finance has the right billing metadata. Our checklist below is required to get the PO routed and payment set up: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (or a SOC 2 Summary + attestation letter)
- ISO 27001 certificate (if applicable)
- Recent external penetration test letter (high-level summary is fine)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached template)
- W-9 or equivalent tax form (US vendors)
- Banking instructions or remit-to details for PO payment

Can you confirm whether you can provide these items and an estimated timeline? Also please confirm the legal entity name and the address we should put on the PO.

We typically aim to issue a PO within 3-7 business days of receiving the packet and completed vendor form, pending legal/finance review. If any items will take longer, let us know and we can triage what to prioritize for PO issuance.

Appreciate a point of contact to escalate to if needed.

Regards,
